payload.query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-26T08:00:00Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-26T12:00:00Z"
        AND host.name == "db-1"
        AND event.outcome == "success"
        AND process.name == "sshd"
| STATS count = COUNT(*),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY message
| SORT count DESC
| LIMIT 20
